name: ServiceDesk Toolkit Corporate
installCommandDev: $env:SDTK_REF = "v2.4-functional"; $Installer = Join-Path $env:TEMP "ServiceDeskToolkit-bootstrap.ps1"; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Caiodalre/ServiceDeskToolkit/v2.4-functional/bootstrap.ps1' -OutFile $Installer -UseBasicParsing; powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $Installer; Remove-Item Env:\SDTK_REF -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
installCommandStable: $env:SDTK_REF = "v2.3.0"; $Installer = Join-Path $env:TEMP "ServiceDeskToolkit-bootstrap.ps1"; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Caiodalre/ServiceDeskToolkit/v2.3.0/bootstrap.ps1' -OutFile $Installer -UseBasicParsing; powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $Installer; Remove-Item Env:\SDTK_REF -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
